# Sajeetharan Sinnathurai

> Principal Product Manager at Microsoft focused on developer tooling, Azure Cosmos DB, coding agents, developer experience, and cloud platforms.

This is the agent-readable index for https://www.sajeetharan.dev. Public resources are read-only and require no API key.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/): Biography, focus areas, featured work, and community contributions.
- [Career and professional profile](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/career): Professional summary, expertise, career history, selected shipped work, official profiles, and direct recruiter contact.
- [Contact](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/contact): Recruiting, collaboration, and speaking enquiries. Contact directly to discuss fit; no job availability or start date is implied.
- [Developer portal](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/developers): Quickstarts, endpoint documentation, CLI usage, and a read-only sandbox.
- [Blog](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/blogs): Long-form technical articles.
- [Topic hub](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/topics): Curated starting points and complete article collections.
- [Azure](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/topics/azure): Cloud development and application projects.
- [Azure Cosmos DB](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/topics/cosmos-db): Data, vector retrieval, and agent memory.
- [AI agents](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/topics/agents): Agent applications and coding workflows.
- [AI engineering](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/topics/ai): Application case studies and evaluation.
- [MCP](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/topics/mcp): Model Context Protocol project experiences.
- [Agent skills](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/topics/skills): Domain guidance and regression evaluation.
- [Projects](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/projects): Open-source and developer-tooling projects.
- [Talks](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/talks): Conference sessions and recordings.
- [Awards](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/awards): Professional and community recognition.
- [Hire Me](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/hire-me): Public recruiter FAQs, career sources, and direct contact. Optional AI answers can be incorrect; use the published facts as the source of truth.

## Featured technical guides

- [Build an AI Agent with Azure Cosmos DB: End-to-End Guide](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/blogs/build-an-ai-agent-with-azure-cosmos-db): A tested TypeScript and React walkthrough covering local development, durable agent memory, tenant isolation, diagnostics, validation, and deployment to Azure.
- [Azure Cosmos DB Agent Starter](https://github.com/sajeetharan/cosmos-agent-starter): Source code, scenarios, local emulator support, and production infrastructure used in the guide.

## Markdown files

The website is served by GitHub Pages. Request the static Markdown files directly: `/index.md` for the homepage, or append `/index.md` to a canonical page path, such as `/developers/index.md` and `/blogs/build-an-ai-agent-with-azure-cosmos-db/index.md`. An `Accept: text/markdown` header on the HTML page URL does not switch formats with the current API-only Worker routes.

The professional profile is also available as [Career Markdown](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/career/index.md). Search visibility and recommendations are not guaranteed by this index.
